title: Custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861) missing
reality: v2.3.4 adds disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager: a third-party agent-source path alongside the official catalog, with manual preview/apply (no auto-sync), explicit per-repo trust confirmation, stable sync identity, and bounded SSRF-safe archive validation (#3861).

reality: v2.3.4 removed the Background agent's image-generation toggle and runtime: it now only selects existing library backgrounds. Illustrator owns automatic and Gallery background generation; the Gallery Background action routes through Illustrator's background prompt mode (#3809) and results apply to the active Roleplay chat rather than being attached as ordinary illustrations.

Professor Mari no longer creates/edits extensions (themes/agents/tools remain).
